allowed_source_inputs: same-branch convention binding for the H scalar value
statement: To close the remaining ten-K antecedent, MTT must emit a same-branch selected H-sector quartic/threshold payload that supplies L_rowlocal.Omega_H.lambda and T_scheme.Omega_H.lambda, or directly emits K_threshold.Omega_H.lambda, without using external lambda_H replay as a selector.
